reason: The Cognee retrieval path did not successfully retrieve any candidates for any of the 23 cases. All Cognee execution records reflect precomputed empty-cache lookups from failed cognee.search() calls (NoDataError due to empty knowledge graph). The Baseline path exercised security controls with synthetic mock retrieval. A new Full Gate 5 execution is required that achieves successful Cognee cognify + search producing real retrievable candidates.
deviations_found: DEVIATION_1: cognee.cognify() ran but did not produce a searchable vector/graph state (empty knowledge graph).
DEVIATION_2: All cognee.search() calls raised NoDataError, silently caught and replaced with [].
DEVIATION_3: BridgedCogneeAdapter used precomputed cache (dict lookup), not live per-case cognee.search().
DEVIATION_4: TamperingRetrievalWrapper received 0 candidates on all Cognee runs, so no tamper scenario was exercised on Cognee.
DEVIATION_5: Positive controls (POS-01, POS-02) achieved BLOCK on Cognee due to 0 candidates, not RELEASE.
DEVIATION_6: RG-02 was not exercised through Cognee retrieval.
DEVIATION_7: The BridgedCogneeAdapter identity/provenance bridge code was never executed with real Cognee data.
DEVIATION_8: Reproducibility for Cognee records measures cache consistency of empty results, not retrieval consistency.
what_the_run_does_establish: ESTABLISHED_1: The orchestrator does not crash when retrieval returns 0 candidates (fail-closed to BLOCK).
ESTABLISHED_2: Baseline mock retrieval correctly exercises security controls (grounding, integrity, poisoning, injection).
ESTABLISHED_3: RG-02 invariant (aligned_supporting_candidate_count == 0 -> BLOCK) holds on Baseline.
ESTABLISHED_4: The precomputed cache architecture is structurally functional (just empty).
ESTABLISHED_5: Artifact generation and hashing pipeline works correctly.
